answer: Each epoch, 20% of agents are randomly selected for a deep re-audit of their key-signed log of completed jobs. A failed audit slashes a 150-unit bond and bans that key. Each fake therefore needs its own 150-unit bond and its own distinct, verifiable job history: a wharf agent certifying yarrow shipments from a meadow supplier cannot lend its log to another identity, since signatures and outcomes are bound to one key. Buying many keys does not cut the 20% risk per identity, so 100 fakes risk 20 slashes, 15,000 units at stake, every epoch.
